vars.processors:
- decode_csv_fields:
    fields:
      message: decoded.csv
    separator: ","
    ignore_missing: false
    overwrite_keys: true
    trim_leading_space: true
    fail_on_error: true

- extract_array:
    field: decoded.csv
    mappings:
      so.ip_address: '0'
      so.description: '1'

- script:
    lang: javascript
    source: >
      function process(event) {
          var ip = event.Get('so.ip_address');
          var validIpRegex = /^((25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d{2}|[1-9]?\d)\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1\d{2}|[1-9]?\d)$/
          if (!validIpRegex.test(ip)) {
              event.Cancel();
          }
      }
- fingerprint:
    fields: ["so.ip_address"]
    target_field: "@metadata._id"
